title: Quick walkthrough to unlock higher throughput for your self-serve project
text:
Quick walkthrough to unlock higher throughput for your self-serve project

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Gutierrez <carlos@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick walkthrough to unlock higher throughput for your self-serve project

Hi Carlos —

Congrats on getting Fintegrate up and running on Redwood. I noticed your org just crossed the 75% usage threshold on the self-serve plan this morning and wanted to offer a short, focused walkthrough to cover:

- How to reduce token cost with prefix caching and batching policies
- A quick look at model/quantization recommendations for embedding-heavy flows
- Options for predictable capacity if you expect sustained usage growth

I can do a 25–30 minute session this week. Does any of the below work for you?

- Thu 3/25: 11:00 AM – 11:30 AM PT
- Thu 3/25: 3:00 PM – 3:30 PM PT
- Fri 3/26: 9:30 AM – 10:00 AM PT

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min

I’ve attached a brief usage snapshot from this morning so we can walk through concrete examples. Dev will join to help with any architecture questions.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage_snapshot_Mar25.csv (CSV — 1KB)

---

From: Carlos Gutierrez <carlos@fintegrate.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:20:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick walkthrough to unlock higher throughput for your self-serve project

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the heads up. Friday morning 9:30 AM PT works for me, but I do need it to be no longer than 30 minutes. If possible, can you share an agenda so I can invite my engineering lead?

Also, quick FYI — we have a spike in embedding requests that started yesterday; happy to share logs if that helps.

Best,
Carlos
Head of Platform Engineering
Fintegrate

> 2) 10 min — batching / cache recommendations + quick config pointers
> 3) 10 min — model/quantization options for embeddings + tradeoffs
> 4) 5 min — next steps / optional Dedicated capacity overview

Perfect — moved the slot to Fri 3/26 10:30 AM PT and sent a calendar invite to you + your engineering lead. Dev will be on the call and we’ll focus primarily on the embedding traffic pattern you mentioned.

Quick note on prep: if you can forward a 15–20 minute sample of recent embedding request logs (pseudonymized is fine) before the call, Dev can pre-check for common anti-patterns (e.g., repeated short contexts or small batch sizes). If that’s not possible, no problem — we’ll diagnose from the snapshot and the live discussion.

If anything else changes, you can reschedule here: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min

Looking forward,
Tessa
SDR, Redwood Inference
